HAGGLE.definition: Wrangle (over a price, terms of an agreement, etc.).
HAGGLE.example: Let's not haggle over a few dollars.

GALE.definition: A strong wind moving 45-90 knots; force 7 to 10 on Beaufort scale.

HALE.gloss: to cause to do through pressure or necessity, by physical, moral or intellectual means
HALE.definition: To cause to do through pressure or necessity, by physical, moral or intellectual means.
HALE.example: She forced him to take a job in the city.

LEG.definition: A human limb; commonly used to refer to a whole limb but technically only the part of the limb between the knee and ankle.

EGG.gloss: animal reproductive body consisting of an ovum or embryo together with nutritive and…
EGG.definition: Animal reproductive body consisting of an ovum or embryo together with nutritive and protective envelopes; especially the thin-shelled reproductive body laid by e.g. female birds.

AGE.example: It was replaced because of its age.

GEL.gloss: a colloid in a more solid form than a sol
GEL.definition: A colloid in a more solid form than a sol.

GAL.gloss: United States liquid unit equal to 4 quarts or 3.785 liters
GAL.definition: United States liquid unit equal to 4 quarts or 3.785 liters.

ALE.gloss: a general name for beer made with a top fermenting yeast
ALE.definition: A general name for beer made with a top fermenting yeast; in some of the United States an ale is (by law) a brew of more than 4% alcohol by volume.

LAG.gloss: the act of slowing down or falling behind
LAG.definition: The act of slowing down or falling behind.

GAG.gloss: a humorous anecdote or remark intended to provoke laughter
GAG.definition: A humorous anecdote or remark intended to provoke laughter.
GAG.example: He told a very funny joke.
